say:1:1621228001:1.text: We're in luck. No bite marks on the fruit, and it doesn't look like any animals got too close.
say:1:1621228001:1.source_cn: 很幸运，这些毒果还没有啃食痕迹，陷阱周围也没有动物靠近...
say:1:1621228001:1.male: We're in luck. No bite marks on the fruit, and it doesn't look like any animals got too close.
say:1:1621228001:1.female: We're in luck. No bite marks on the fruit, and it doesn't look like any animals got too close.

say:2:1621228002:1.text: Good thing we got here in time. Looks like we won't need Hamell's remedy after all.
say:2:1621228002:1.source_cn: 我来得够及时，哈梅尔先生的药草暂时用不上了。
say:2:1621228002:1.male: Good thing we got here in time. Looks like we won't need Hamell's remedy after all.
say:2:1621228002:1.female: Good thing we got here in time. Looks like we won't need Hamell's remedy after all.

say:3:1621228003:1.text: But... this trap is built just like the one we found earlier. Probably the same people who set it.
say:3:1621228003:1.source_cn: 不过……这个陷阱的构造，和上次发现的如出一辙，应该是同...
say:3:1621228003:1.male: But... this trap is built just like the one we found earlier. Probably the same people who set it.
say:3:1621228003:1.female: But... this trap is built just like the one we found earlier. Probably the same people who set it.

say:4:1621228004:0.text: And they're still at it. There are more traps out here now.
say:4:1621228004:0.source_cn: 他们持续在向森林投放，而且数量比之前更多了。
say:4:1621228004:0.male: And they're still at it. There are more traps out here now.
say:4:1621228004:0.female: And they're still at it. There are more traps out here now.

say:5:1621228005:0.text: Magister, can you sense anything from the magic on this one?
say:5:1621228005:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，你能从这个陷阱的魔力上察觉到什么吗？
say:5:1621228005:0.male: Magister, can you sense anything from the magic on this one?
say:5:1621228005:0.female: Magister, can you sense anything from the magic on this one?

say:8:1621228007:0.source_cn: 一缕几近消散的魔力沿着你的感知缓缓游走，仿佛在夜色深处...

say:10:1621228009:1.text: You shake your head at Cassadee, resigned.
say:10:1621228009:1.source_cn: 你无奈地向科丝蒂摇了摇头。
say:10:1621228009:1.male: You shake your head at Cassadee, resigned.
say:10:1621228009:1.female: You shake your head at Cassadee, resigned.

say:11:1621228010:0.text: Phew... even you can't pick up anything, Magister? The magic in this thing is barely there. No wonder it's impossible to track.
